target_year_over_year_context.explanation: The 2023 disclosure (ms_2023_7_D090) covers the projected future compensation obligation for DCP. It contains two main components: 1) The accounting treatment/rollforward basis (reflected in Other liabilities, excludes market condition assumptions, performance years) and 2) The segment distribution breakdown. The 2024 disclosures split this: D094 covers the accounting treatment/balance location/rollforward basis, and D095 covers the segment distribution breakdown. Both 2024 items are subsets of the original 2023 topic.

previous_disclosures.summary: The firm's estimated projected future compensation obligation for existing deferred cash-based compensation awards, exclusive of assumptions about future market conditions, relates to performance years 2023 and prior, is reflected in Other liabilities and accrued expenses as of December 31, 2023, and does not include assumptions regarding forfeitures. Approximately 20% of the obligation relates to Institutional Securities, 70% to Wealth Management, and 10% to Investment Management, with distributions after February of each year generally considered immaterial.
